title: Comic Strips
text:
Many people love comic strips. A comic strip is a short story with pictures and words. It usually has three or four panels. Each panel shows one moment of the story.

Some comic strips are very funny. The characters often say short things in speech bubbles. Many newspapers print a comic strip every day. Children and adults both enjoy them.

questions.text: How many panels does a comic strip usually have?
Where do the characters often put their short words?
Why do many people like comic strips?
options: They are short and fun to read

questions.text: What can you infer about comic strips in newspapers?
options: They are only sold in shops

vocabulary.definition: a short story told with pictures and words
a person or animal in a story
one picture box in a comic strip

paragraph_translations: Багато людей люблять комікси. Комікс — це коротка історія з малюнками та словами. Зазвичай він має три-чотири кадри. Кожен кадр показує один момент історії.
Деякі комікси дуже смішні. Персонажі часто говорять коротко у хмаринках. Багато газет друкують комікс кожного дня. І діти, і дорослі люблять їх.
